line_move_fixes_point_matches_market.name: line_move_fixes_point_matches_market
line_move_fixes_point_matches_market.value:
CASE WHEN "line_move_fixes"."price1" IS NULL OR "line_move_fixes"."market_type" = 'h2h' THEN "line_move_fixes"."point" IS NULL
        ELSE "line_move_fixes"."point" IS NOT NULL END

line_move_fixes_valid_american_prices.name: line_move_fixes_valid_american_prices
line_move_fixes_valid_american_prices.value:
"line_move_fixes"."price1" IS NULL OR (("line_move_fixes"."price1" <= -100 OR "line_move_fixes"."price1" >= 100)
        AND ("line_move_fixes"."price2" <= -100 OR "line_move_fixes"."price2" >= 100))

line_moves_point_matches_market.name: line_moves_point_matches_market
line_moves_point_matches_market.value:
CASE WHEN "line_moves"."price1" IS NULL OR "line_moves"."market_type" = 'h2h' THEN "line_moves"."point" IS NULL
        ELSE "line_moves"."point" IS NOT NULL END

line_moves_valid_american_prices.name: line_moves_valid_american_prices
line_moves_valid_american_prices.value:
"line_moves"."price1" IS NULL OR (("line_moves"."price1" <= -100 OR "line_moves"."price1" >= 100)
        AND ("line_moves"."price2" <= -100 OR "line_moves"."price2" >= 100))

odds_observations_selection_matches_mark.name: odds_observations_selection_matches_market
odds_observations_selection_matches_mark.value:
("odds_observations"."market_type" IN ('h2h', 'spreads') AND "odds_observations"."selection" IN ('HOME', 'AWAY'))
        OR ("odds_observations"."market_type" = 'totals' AND "odds_observations"."selection" IN ('OVER', 'UNDER'))

paper_positions_teaser_shape.name: paper_positions_teaser_shape
paper_positions_teaser_shape.value:
("paper_positions"."market" = 'teaser_leg') = ("paper_positions"."teased_line" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("paper_positions"."market" = 'teaser_leg' OR "paper_positions"."price" IS NOT NULL)

season_projections_p_range.name: season_projections_p_range
season_projections_p_range.value: "season_projections"."playoff_p" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "season_projections"."division_p" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "season_projections"."seed1_p" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "season_projections"."conf_p" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "season_projections"."sb_p" BETWEEN 0 AND 1
